items.title: End of the 'Lag 7'? What Nvidia's earnings mean for the rest of tech.
items.summary: Slatestone Wealth Chief Market Strategist Kenny Polcari, F.L. Putnam Investment Management Co. Chief Market Strategist and Portfolio Manager Ellen Hazen, and Prime Capital Financial Chief Investment Officer Will McGough join Yahoo Finance's Brooke DiPalma to discuss Nvidia's (NVDA) latest earnings report, concerns about circular financing, and whether it's the end of the Magnificent Seven's lackluster performance.

items.title: Just how big of a problem area is China for Nvidia?
items.summary: Josh Lipton uses Yahoo Finance's AlphaSpace platform to take a closer look at Nvidia's (NVDA) post-earnings stock gains. He is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to further examine China's place in the broader, global AI ecosystem and how much the nation factors into Nvidia's chip business.

items.title: Inside Nvidia and SpaceX’s growing relationship
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to explore the growing relationship between Nvidia (NVDA) and SpaceX (SPCX), as the space giant is set to become one of the first customers to receive Nvidia’s next-generation Vera Rubin CPU.

items.title: Stocks, dollar rise after Fed chief lifts rate expectations
items.summary: Stocks advanced and the dollar spiked higher Friday after Federal Reserve chief Kevin Warsh called high inflation "concerning", fanning expectations the central bank will raise interest rates to keep prices in check.That assessment reassured stock investors despite the prospect of higher borrowing costs, with expectations rising of a Fed rate hike by December.

items.title: CBRS' Global Expansion Boosts Growth Prospects Against NVDA & MSFT
items.summary: Cerebras expands AI inference infrastructure across Europe and Canada as it targets global demand and challenges NVIDIA and Microsoft.

items.title: Drone Stocks Drop While Broad Market Rises: Unusual Machines Sinks 9%, Ondas Falls 6%, Red Cat Slides 5%
items.summary: Drone stocks are selling off hard at midday while the broader market climbs, and no earnings miss, contract loss, or macro scare explains the divergence. Something specific is happening inside the drone complex that has nothing to do with the headlines.
